excavation_context.character_description: Adult female grad student museum preparator, short blonde hair, lightly tanned skin, wearing a light blue tee shirt under a white lab coat, white skirt, and light blue pumps.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_2 is leaning forward over an un-fissile shelf of dark green-grey mudstone matrix inside a preservation lab. She uses a fine scalpel to systematically uncover a row of robust predatory theropod tail vertebrae trapped in the block. Soft overhead museum lighting illuminating her blue pumps and the dense green-grey matrix texture. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
